title: The stability of boundary equilibria of three-dimensional Filippov systems
summary: For three-dimensional piecewise-smooth systems of ordinary differential equations, this paper characterises the stability of points that belong to a switching surface and are equilibria of exactly one of the two neighbouring pieces of the system. Stability is challenging to characterise when nearby orbits repeatedly switch between regular motion on one side of the switching surface, and sliding motion on the switching surface, as defined via Filippov's convention.
